gzowo.name: Kontemplujący Beethoven
gzowo.text: Beethoven, the deaf white cat, greets the sun over the misty Narew.

gzowo.name: Logo Gzowo 34
gzowo.text: The white octopus on black.

gzowo.name: The Orange Beauty
gzowo.text: Jurek's rocket in full glory, shot at 0.5x from below.

gzowo.name: Jurek z Dropsikiem
gzowo.text: A summer hug with the dog.

gzowo.name: Malowanie Światłem
gzowo.text: Painting with light by the campfire, on a long exposure.

gzowo.name: Stara tablica ośrodka FSO
gzowo.text: Fabryka Samochodów Osobowych, Ośrodek Wędkarski w Gzowie. A keepsake from the old resort.

gzowo.name: Waldek pozuje z helikopterem
gzowo.text: A navy Airbus, SP-MMM, landed on the bluff in 2022. Kropka the dog guards the skid.

gzowo.name: Jan Sukiennik z kozą nad Narwią
gzowo.text: The Resort Manager in his white fur, with the goat that stayed for one Christmas.

gzowo.name: Wieżowiec gotów do startu
gzowo.text: Ready for launch, 100%. The perfect cover for a new Beatles album.

gzowo.name: Gzofajfus Classic Mk IV
gzowo.text: Lying on the meadow after a great success, parachute still attached.

gzowo.name: Pilot Jan
gzowo.text: Controller in hand, out in nature.

gzowo.name: Luna
gzowo.text: A quiet night and a lonely moon.

gzowo.name: Słońce nad polem
gzowo.text: Jurek experiences a sunset.

gzowo.name: Klucz Ptaków
gzowo.text: Birds coming back across the spring sky.

gzowo.name: Zimowy Obiad Jurka
gzowo.text: Mmm, yummy!

gzowo.name: Strike a pose!
gzowo.text: A little Superman in the spotlight!

gzowo.name: Domek nr 1
gzowo.text: A dark wooden cabin with a red door, from the old FSO resort. Three of ten are left.

gzowo.name: Architektoniczny wieżowiec
gzowo.text: Dad's 3D printed rocket, built and styled like a skyscraper.

gzowo.name: Wieżowiec gotów do startu V2
gzowo.text: Jurek sets the rocket up on the gravel road. Ready, 100%.

gzowo.name: Dron w chmurach
gzowo.text: The Avata in flight.

gzowo.name: Rysio na desce SUP
gzowo.text: Rysio is having a great time on the SUP!

gzowo.name: Krowi chłopiec
gzowo.text: Resting in the yard together (alligator included).

gzowo.name: Czytanie w Domu
gzowo.text: A lazy day on the couch.

gzowo.name: Zimowy Obiad Rysia
gzowo.text: Mmm, yummy!

gzowo.name: Rakieta na wyrzutni
gzowo.text: On the pad in the middle of a flat meadow, under a cloudy sky.

gzowo.name: Dwie rakiety na tle próbek
gzowo.text: Two printed rockets, dark green and light green, in front of the filament samples.

gzowo.name: Warsztat rakietowy
gzowo.text: Green rockets and parts, mid-assembly under the pegboard.

gzowo.name: Mapa geodezyjna działki
gzowo.text: The survey map, photographed a month before the plot became the Sukienniks'.

gzowo.name: Narew
gzowo.text: Reeds in the shallows, blue sky, the far bank a long way off.

gzowo.name: Plaża
gzowo.text: The sandy slope down to the water, where the kayaks and the SUP go in.

map.name: Szyszka
map.text: The pine cone money of Gzowo. Earned on the plot, never bought.

map.name: GSP Rocket
map.text: Press START, count down from ten, and it comes back on a parachute.

map.name: Gzowo St. Exchange
map.text: GZM and GZF rise and fall with the Narew and the wind.

map.name: StarNet Planetarium
map.text: Every project in one net of stars.

map.name: Launch Pad
map.text: Where every rocket on the plot begins.

map.name: Arcade
map.text: All the games live here.

map.name: Lab
map.text: Software and AI, with a dish on the roof.

map.name: Workshop
map.text: Home of the 3D printers.

map.name: GSP Hangar
map.text: Open the doors and look at the fleet.

map.name: Museum
map.text: Paint a picture, let Haiku judge it, sell it for szyszki.

map.name: Coaster Station
map.text: A ride in the clouds over Gzowo Street.

map.name: Card Kiosk
map.text: You are holding what it sells.

map.name: Claw Machine
map.text: Three free tries a day. The claw has opinions.

map.name: Sun
map.text: Shines over the plot until a cloud gets clicked.

map.name: Store
map.text: Fireworks, balloons and outfits, all for szyszki.

map.name: Cork Board
map.text: Pin a note or a drawing. It hangs for a week.

map.name: Changing Booth
map.text: New outfit? Looking good.

map.name: Sailboat
map.text: Drifts down the Narew all day.

map.name: Seagull
map.text: Watches the river. Judges quietly.

map.name: Dock
map.text: Click it to go fishing.

map.name: Mailbox
map.text: The guestbook. Leave a message.

map.name: Billboard
map.text: A random visitor review in big letters.

map.name: Signpost
map.text: Points at what this place is about.

map.name: Bench
map.text: A good seat for watching rockets.

map.name: Street Lamp
map.text: Lights the way down Gzowo Street.

map.name: Pine
map.text: Where szyszki come from.

map.name: Tree
map.text: Changes with the season.

map.name: Windsock
map.text: Shows which way the wind goes before a launch.

map.name: Satellite Dish
map.text: Listens to the sky next to the planetarium.

map.name: Cloud
map.text: Click it and it starts to rain.
